title: Exit Script inside Loop
description: Error-prone rule — Exit Script executed inside a Loop. Leaving a script mid-loop skips the loop cleanup and surprises callers.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Exiting inside a loop bypasses any post-loop logic and makes control flow hard to follow.
rule.remediation: Set a flag and Exit Loop If, then exit the script after the loop.
